body:

This is my map called Lonely Mine. I've been on Avicus around 3 months and I've always wanted to have a map on nebula. It's a pretty smallmap but I made it that way so it could be a fun short map with lots of pvp space and bow space. The monuments are in igloos and they have 3 openings in the igloos. There's a Choice of diamond and iron and each team has same amount of diamond blocks. Te hole in the middle is big but not to big :D and also each team has a pool of ice as well In Lonely Mine it's the green team (Drillers) vs Orange (miners) so that's my nebula map and please gov me reviews becuase I really want this to go on nebula thx!      -Captain_Craft755
